prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1283; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a sideswipe sustained while changing lanes. The damage to the right rear quarter panel, rear door, and adjacent trim is consistent with the reported impact path, and the scrape pattern and paint transfer line up with the other vehicle's described contact point. Repair plan calls for panel straightening, replacement of the damaged door skin, refinishing, and reinstallation of the trim clips. The labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage and the sequence of work. Invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operations. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file or from the owner's account.
